ko.value: 지리적인 면에서 다른 곳과는 구별되는 지표상의 공간적 범위

value.text: Demarcated areas of the earth that are homogeneous in terms of natural, historic, economic, political, or cultural characteristics that distinguish them from other areas.
A geographic region is a spatial region whose boundaries are typically defined against some material frame of reference (like the earth).
